def product_except_self(xs):
    n = len(xs)
    out = [1] * n
    p = 1
    for i in range(n):
        out[i] = p
        p *= xs[i]
    s = 1
    for i in range(n - 1, -1, -1):
        out[i] *= s
        s *= xs[i]
    return out
```
